meta.description: A stripe pattern on a disc that grows outward ring by ring, like gills under a cap: where the circumference grows, new stripes start between others or fork off, so the stripes stay about spacing apart.

radius.description: Outer radius of the disc, the pattern reaches this far from the axis

inner_radius.description: Where the pattern starts, with its stripes at their closest. For gills: the stipe radius plus the free distance.

alignment.description: 0 = a winding labyrinth, 1 = straight stripes running outward

irregularity.description: 0 = even stripes that get new ones between them all at the same radius, 1 = uneven stripes that get new ones one by one

forking.description: 0 = new stripes start between two others, like the short gills (lamellulae) of Agaricus, 1 = they split off a stripe, like forked gills

steps.description: How long the pattern settles at every ring as the disc grows. More steps are smoother and slower.
